test_title: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 02 Sept, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Train A leaves station M at 6:30 AM and reaches station N at 3:30 PM on the same day. Train B leaves station N at 8:30 AM and reaches station M at 1:30 PM on the same day. Find the time when trains A and B meet.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Time taken** by **Train A** = 9 hours; **Train B** = 5 hours.

Let **Total Distance** = LCM(9, 5) = 45 units.

**Speed A** = 45 ÷ 9 = 5 units/h; **Speed B** = 45 ÷ 5 = 9 units/h.

By 8:30 AM (2 hours), Train A covers 10 units. **Remaining distance** = 35 units.

**Relative speed** = 5 + 9 = 14 units/h. Meeting time = 35 ÷ 14 = 2.5 hours after 8:30 AM.

**∴ The correct answer is 11:00 AM.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/078001d59ed16ccb8893060a721e12b858e79b49f284a1c3797d63b631b2c8fe.png] 

**Given:**

**Train A:** 6:30 AM to 3:30 PM = 9 hours.

**Train B:** 8:30 AM to 1:30 PM = 5 hours.

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let distance **MN** = D km.

⇒ Speed of **Train A** (SA) = D/9 km/h.

⇒ Speed of **Train B** (SB) = D/5 km/h.

⇒ Distance covered by **Train A** in 2 hours (6:30 to 8:30) = 2 × (D/9) = 2D/9.

⇒ Remaining distance at 8:30 AM = D − 2D/9 = 7D/9.

⇒ Time to meet = (Remaining Distance) ÷ (Relative Speed)

⇒ Time = (7D/9) ÷ (D/9 + D/5) = (7D/9) ÷ (14D/45)

⇒ Time = (7/9) × (45/14) = 5/2 = 2.5 hours.

⇒ Meeting time = 8:30 AM + 2 hours 30 minutes = 11:00 AM.

**∴ The correct answer is 11:00 AM.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Relative Speed

When two objects move in opposite directions, relative speed is the sum of their individual speeds (S₁ + S₂).

Meeting Time Formula

Meeting Time = (Initial distance between them at the same start time) ÷ (Relative Speed).

Average Speed

For a round trip with speeds x and y, Average Speed = 2xy ÷ (x + y).</p
